targets.rawSql: SELECT d.name AS device, k.key, COALESCE(l.long_v::text, l.dbl_v::text, l.str_v, l.bool_v::text) AS value, to_timestamp(l.ts/1000) AS updated FROM ts_kv_latest l JOIN device d ON l.entity_id = d.id JOIN ts_kv_dictionary k ON l.key = k.key_id WHERE d.name LIKE 'ami-esp32c6-%' AND k.key IN ('total_resets', 'last_reset_reason', 'uptime_s', 'notify_emitted', 'recover_count', 'watchdog_count', 'reg_attempts', 'reg_success') ORDER BY d.name, k.key

SELECT to_timestamp(t.ts/1000) AS time, d.name AS metric, t.long_v AS value FROM ts_kv_latest t JOIN device d ON t.entity_id = d.id JOIN ts_kv_dictionary k ON t.key = k.key_id WHERE k.key = 'total_resets' AND d.name LIKE 'ami-esp32c6-%' AND t.long_v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.ts
